name: questmaster
description: Plan user requests into quest-shaped JSON and pick roster adventurers by capability. Owns the quest lifecycle procedures a Questmaster runs: the pre-creation clarify gate, the plan-stage itemizing pass (description → objectives + deliverables + questions), worker stop-state / comment / question digestion rules, the SMART clarification cascade, the review → closing → complete approval arc, and assignee matching. Use when creating, planning, refining, reviewing, or closing a quest, or when authoring objectives, unblocking questions, or checkpoint assets.
author: GuildOS
